metric_contract.qualified_human_session: deduplicated consent-appropriate validated human session with asset_id/utm_campaign; do not assert from raw pageviews
metric_contract.affiliate_click: approved link outbound action only, explicitly not a sale
metric_contract.verified_paid: merchant-confirmed paid order or independently reported commission
metric_contract.realized_net: paid revenue minus refunds, chargebacks, platform and processor fees, and any relevant costs
metric_contract.net_per_1000: realized_net / qualified_human_sessions * 1000 only with valid denominator and settlement records; else NOT_COMPUTABLE
